card.name: Scattered news-text words, no clear theme
card.fires_on: No single word type; it fires on scattered tokens in news and science web text, such as a plus sign after a number, a letter inside a year, or a word like note or form.

card.writes: Suppresses Chinese news-style tokens (such as 本报 and 昨日) and words like professors and scientists; the effect is weak and mixed.
